types.name: RouteEntry

fields.name: path
fields.description: URL path segment, e.g. '/step-0-cartographer' or '/' for home.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Human-readable navigation label shown in the Sidebar, e.g. 'Step 0 — Cartographer'.

fields.name: componentKey
fields.description: Lookup key that maps this route to its lazy-loaded or statically-imported page component.

types.description: A single route definition consumed by both the router configuration and the Sidebar navigation.

types.name: RouteManifest
types.description: Ordered array of all 13 route entries; single source of truth for navigation and routing.

types.name: PageComponentKey
types.description: Discriminator enum identifying each of the 13 page components.

types.name: CalloutType
types.description: Visual variant for a CalloutBox — determines border color, icon, and background tint.

types.name: CalloutBoxProps

fields.name: type
fields.description: Visual style variant (gotcha, warning, or tip).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Optional bold heading rendered above the body text.

types.description: Props accepted by the CalloutBox component; used by every page component to render callouts.

types.name: CodeBlockProps

fields.name: code
fields.description: The verbatim CLI command or code snippet to display.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Prism language identifier for syntax highlighting.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Optional filename or label shown above the code block.

types.description: Props accepted by the CodeBlock component; used by every page to render CLI commands with syntax highlighting and copy button.

types.name: VersionBadgeProps

fields.name: version
fields.description: Semantic version string to display, e.g. '1.2.3'.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Optional tool name rendered before the version number.

types.description: Props accepted by the VersionBadge component; used by page components to show component version pills.

types.name: VideoEmbedProps

fields.name: url
fields.description: Full YouTube video URL (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=... or https://youtu.be/...).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Accessible title for the iframe element.

types.description: Props accepted by the VideoEmbed component; used by page components to embed YouTube walkthroughs.

types.name: SidebarProps

fields.name: routes
fields.description: The full ordered list of routes to render as nav links.

types.description: Props accepted by the Sidebar component; receives the route manifest to render navigation links.

types.name: PageLayoutProps

fields.name: routes
fields.description: Route manifest forwarded to the Sidebar for navigation rendering.

fields.name: children
fields.description: Page content rendered in the main content area.

types.description: Props accepted by the PageLayout shell component; wraps Sidebar + scrollable content area.

types.name: ReactNode
types.description: React.ReactNode — opaque type representing renderable JSX children.
